response.sql: WITH baseline AS (SELECT AVG(amount - spent) AS avg_difference FROM budget), status_averages AS (SELECT event_status AS status, AVG(amount - spent) AS avg_difference FROM budget GROUP BY event_status) SELECT s.status, s.avg_difference AS average, s.avg_difference - b.avg_difference AS difference_from_baseline FROM status_averages AS s CROSS JOIN baseline AS b WHERE b.avg_difference IS NOT NULL AND s.avg_difference IS NOT NULL
